tier_1.title: 海と港 (Sea and Port)
tier_1.description: Identify the ports of Japan and the waters they face. Each agent-student pair names a port together.

lessons.name: Identify Japanese ports
lessons.grading: agents must demonstrate they can also identify ports the student names back

tier_2.title: 海流 (Currents)
tier_2.description: Understand the currents and routes. The agent tells the story of one route; the student tells one back.

lessons.name: Map a current
lessons.grading: agents must produce a story AND receive one — the cell-graph has equal inbound and outbound on student-room

tier_3.title: 海図 (Charts)
tier_3.description: Read historical charts. The teacher learns a chart the student brings; the student learns a chart the teacher brings.

lessons.name: Decode a historical chart
lessons.grading: witness-log must show bidirectional attribution — same number of outbound citations in each direction

framing_specifics.rotation_rule: every agent pair must exchange equally within a scene
